## Core Question

Can we infer a tree by minimizing character changes?

## Lesson Scaffold

- Define a character matrix.
- State the parsimony objective.
- Run Fitch's algorithm on a fixed tree.
- Explain why tree search is hard.
- Contrast distance and character methods.
